turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why was there a zero on my son's essay before anyone called me?
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that it?
I don't need more proof than that.

"I don't need more proof than that." I'm writing that down, Hale. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, and 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in. You did neither, so the zero comes off today.
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
"Unlike some people." Which people, Hale? My child doesn't lie, and if you're calling me a liar too, say it plainly so I can write it down exactly.
"Zero stands." Under which section of your procedure, Hale? Because I have the page in front of me, and if you can't point to one, my next stop is the principal's office.
